description: Front-facing goblin scout with ears larger than its face, green skin, mustard headscarf, compact leather gear, and a small dagger. Cute but slightly mean expression; designed as the weakest enemy of the opening region.
usage: Basic enemy sprite facing the player wizard in early combat encounters.
style_summary: Same coarse, polished pixel-art language as the wizard: 59-cell-tall character scale, broad readable shapes, colored outline, soft multi-step shading, and upper-left key light.

visual_identity.primary_read: very wide oversized ears extending beyond the head

silhouette_profile: Wide ear span, compact head and torso, short bent limbs, dagger on viewer-left side.

proportion_profile.ear_to_face_relation: ears are intentionally larger/wider than the face

pixel_structure.method_note: Final output is rebuilt onto a logical 59-cell height and enlarged by nearest-neighbor blocks; no palette quantization was applied.

pixel_density: same character pixel density as wizard_back; approximately 7x7 physical pixels per logical cell

forbidden: turquoise/cyan identity accent reserved for the wizard

shading_profile: Several tonal steps per material with soft transitions retained inside coarse blocks; no fixed-palette reduction.

lighting_profile.highlight_behavior: headscarf, left ear edge, forehead and dagger receive the clearest highlights

outline_profile: Dark colored outlines derived from local green, brown and yellow material colors; avoid pure black.
detail_density: medium around face, ears and dagger; low on limbs and torso to preserve weak-enemy readability.
readability_rules: Ear span must remain the first-read silhouette cue.
Mustard headscarf must stay visually distinct from green skin.
Dagger must remain small so the enemy reads as low threat.
Keep expression mildly mischievous rather than frightening.
mood/world_context: weak opening-area forest enemy; playful threat rather than horror
allowed_variations: attack/hit animation poses with same proportions
variant_generation_notes: Keep ear width and headscarf as the two strongest landmarks. Build future frames directly at the same 59-cell logical height.
relation_to_other_assets: Matches wizard_back in logical height and block size; uses a distinct non-turquoise enemy palette. Designed to stand clearly over bg_forest.
reference_basis: ART_REQUEST_PHASE1_5.md for enemy design and the supplied wizard image only for shared rendering language and scale.
originality_note: Original goblin scout design for this project; based on generic fantasy goblin concepts without copying a specific commercial-game asset.
license_risk_check: Low; no identifiable third-party insignia, logo, or distinctive protected character design intentionally reproduced.
